title: Chetter inbound webhook endpoint definition
description: Git-managed inbound endpoint that lets external systems submit authenticated events which Chetter durably turns into one configured action (create_task). Secrets are referenced by environment variable name only and are never stored or returned.

name.description: Endpoint name; must equal the definition file name stem.

secret_env.description: Server environment variable holding the shared secret. The value is resolved at request time and never stored, listed, logged, or returned.

signature_header.description: Request header carrying the HMAC-SHA256 signature (hmac_sha256 only). Defaults to X-Chetter-Signature.

signature_prefix.description: Optional prefix prepended to the hex digest before comparison, e.g. sha256= (hmac_sha256 only).

delivery_id_header.description: Optional request header carrying a client replay key; redelivering the same key for this endpoint is idempotent.

event_type_header.description: Optional request header naming the event type, matched against accepted_events.

accepted_events.description: Optional allowlist of event types this endpoint acts on; empty accepts every event. Requires event_type_header.

prompt.description: Task prompt; a strict Go template over normalized metadata ({{ .EventType }}, {{ .DeliveryID }}, {{ .EndpointName }}, {{ .SourceIP }}) and the decoded JSON payload ({{ .Payload.<field> }}).

team_name.description: Fixed action team. Required for global endpoints; forbidden for team-scoped endpoints (the team is inherited from the groups/<team>/ directory). Payload data can never select the team.
